blocks.content: The diagram primitive forwards source to Mermaid v10 with theme:'base'; no diagram type is gated. Tested in this kit: flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, journey, gantt, pie, requirement, gitGraph, c4, mindmap, timeline, quadrantChart, sankey-beta, xychart-beta, block-beta, packet-beta, architecture-beta. Each one inherits the page's accent / surface / text tokens via the kit's themeVariables map, so light/dark mode tracks automatically.
Actors / lifelines / signals — best for protocol or call flows.
